name: USGS/EPA Water Quality Portal (WQP)
description: The Water Quality Portal (WQP) is the United States' premier collaborative repository of in-situ water quality data, integrating records from the USGS National Water Information System (NWIS), the EPA Water Quality Exchange (WQX / STORET), and the USDA Agricultural Research Service (STEWARDS). WQP standardizes and serves over 400 million water monitoring results from more than 2.1 million monitoring stations across the United States and its territories, detailing chemical concentrations, biological metrics, physical water parameters, and sampling provenance.
